_comment: Skill ids referenced but NOT owned as bodies in this library: plugin = an installed host plugin, builtin = Anthropic-shipped. Convenium.Design prefers bundling: since 2026-10-08 apple-design, emil-design-eng, impeccable and every gsap-* skill are bundled bodies projected to all hosts, because host plugin sets vary between sessions on the same machine. `seo-audit` is external (marketing, out of scope for the design library).
